An '''Environment Field Belt''' was a piece of technology employed by the [[Ergesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It generated a [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]] field, allowing an Ergesh to survive in standard [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
